profile.description: Explicit device profile selection. Every runtime instance must select a concrete profile through this field or the CLI; there is no implicit engine profile.

ip.description: Controller-facing device identity or transport IP. For gateway profiles this is not automatically a WAN or LAN port address; assign gateway data-plane IPs with port_overrides[].ip.

instance_guard.description: Host-global duplicate instance guard. fail aborts a second live daemon, warn logs and continues, off disables the guard for intentional multi-instance labs.

instance_guard_path.description: Advisory lock file path used by instance_guard.

interval_seconds.description: Operator-selected base interval for discovery and inform traffic.

controller_interval_min_seconds.description: Lower bound applied to positive controller heartbeat interval hints.

controller_interval_max_seconds.description: Upper bound applied to positive controller heartbeat interval hints. Must not be below controller_interval_min_seconds; controller hints are never accepted above 300 seconds.

inform_backoff_max_seconds.description: Maximum failed-heartbeat retry delay. The effective interval remains a lower bound so backoff never accelerates informs.

inform_backoff_jitter_percent.description: Symmetric random jitter percentage applied to exponential inform retry delays.

management_lan.description: Switch management VLAN model. Gateway profiles keep WAN/LAN data-plane assignments in port_overrides instead of management_lan.

ssh_listen.description: Optional built-in advanced-adoption SSH listen address. Leave empty for the normal inform-based adoption path; enable only in isolated labs that need SSH/set-inform compatibility.

ssh_user.description: Username accepted by the optional advanced-adoption SSH shim when ssh_listen is enabled.

ssh_password.description: Password accepted by the optional advanced-adoption SSH shim when ssh_listen is enabled.

management_lan.description: Structured switch management VLAN metadata and optional preexisting-interface source binding. It does not create host VLANs and is not used to model gateway WAN/LAN ports.

type.description: Neighbor type; defaults to usw for uplink_neighbor.

remote_port.description: Optional one-based port number on the neighboring device.

type.description: Neighbor type; defaults to client for port_neighbors.

remote_port.description: Optional one-based port number on the neighboring device.

source.description: Read-only local gateway WAN diagnostic source. off disables probing, static exposes port_overrides wan_* hints only in local status, and ping runs the local OS ping command and updates local status only; none of these modes claims firmware WAN-health or speed-test telemetry.

interval_seconds.description: Sampling interval for active WAN health probes. It has no effect when source is off or static.

timeout_ms.description: Per-target timeout for active WAN health probes.

targets.description: Ping targets mapped to effective gateway WAN or WAN2 ports. The port selects the local diagnostic entry; the ICMP packet follows normal host routing.

port.description: One-based represented UniFi port index. The resolved port role must be wan or wan2 when source is ping.

host.description: IP address or hostname passed to the local ping command.

name.description: Optional controller display name for this represented port.

interface.description: Local host interface used as read-only source data for this port. Gateway payloads expose it as source_interface, not as controller ifname.

mac.description: Optional MAC override for the represented port.

ip.description: Optional IPv4 address shown for the represented gateway interface.

netmask.description: Optional IPv4 netmask paired with ip for the represented gateway interface.

ipv6.description: Optional non-link-local IPv6 CIDR addresses shown for the represented gateway interface.

role.description: Effective gateway function for this profile port. It does not rename the profile-derived controller ifname.

network_group.description: Controller network group label mirrored into gateway tables, for example WAN, WAN2, or LAN. This is payload metadata only.

portconf_id.description: Optional controller port profile assignment ID mirrored into gateway port tables. It is not applied to the host.

networkconf_id.description: Optional controller network assignment ID mirrored into gateway WAN/LAN metadata. It is not applied to the controller or host.

native_networkconf_id.description: Optional native network assignment ID mirrored into gateway switch-port metadata. It is display/payload data only.

network_name.description: Optional controller network display name mirrored into gateway tables.

vlan.description: Controller display metadata mirrored into gateway tables. The daemon does not create VLANs, edit VLAN profiles, or mutate host interfaces.

wan_uptime_percent.description: Static local WAN availability hint. It affects local diagnostic status only and never creates controller WAN-SLA or speed-test fields.

wan_latency_ms.description: Static local WAN latency hint in milliseconds. It affects local diagnostic status only.

wan_downtime_seconds.description: Static local WAN downtime hint in seconds. It affects local diagnostic status only.

wan_connected.description: Static local WAN connected-state hint. It affects local diagnostic status only.

speed.description: Optional represented link speed in Mbps. It changes payload display only.

media.description: Optional represented media label such as RJ45 or SFP+.

up.description: Optional represented link-state override. It does not administratively change the host port.
